Definition: a Mitsrite, or inhabitant of Mitsrajim
BiblicalUsage: The word is an Egyptian, a man of Egypt, and it runs from the first murder to the last mercy. Moses slew the Egyptian who smote a Hebrew, God promised to deliver His people out of the hand of the Egyptians, and David's men found an Egyptian servant left to die in the field and fed him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the Egyptian is the reminder that Egypt is not only a nation but a people: God judges the nation and feeds the servant, and the same hand that smote Egypt saved the Egyptian.
